mapper.sql: SELECT la.loan_apply_id, COALESCE(la.external_loan_apply_no, CONCAT('REVIEW-LOAN-', la.loan_apply_id)) AS loan_apply_no, up.partner_user_id, COALESCE(la.lender_user_id, CONCAT('REVIEW-USER-', up.partner_user_id)) AS lender_user_id, COALESCE(la.bill_no, CONCAT('BILL-', la.loan_apply_id)) AS bill_no, la.apply_amt AS apply_amount, la.pay_amount, COALESCE(la.pay_time, la.updated_at) AS pay_time FROM loan_application la JOIN user_profile up ON up.id = la.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_profile up JOIN credit_lender_status_query clsq ON clsq.user_id = up.id WHERE up.mobile_no = #{mobileNo} AND clsq.external_status = 'SUCCESS' )
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM user_profile up JOIN loan_application la ON la.user_id = up.id WHERE up.mobile_no = #{mobileNo} AND la.status = 'DISBURSED' )
